simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to סַר (H5620) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: סַר (çar) means peevish First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 20 43.

definitions.full: H5620. sar סַר adjective stubborn, resentful, sullen, implacable ; — וְזָעֵף סַר 1Kin 20:43 ; 21:4 ; feminine סָרָ֫ה רוּחֲךָ מַהזֶּֿה 21:5 why then is thy spirit sullen ? possibly also plural construct סוֺרְרִים סָרֵי Jer 6:28 revolters ( stubborn ones ) among, etc. (see above and סור Qal near the end).
